---
title: Built-in syntax highlighting
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      dom-parity: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        # Code block: outer container carries `sourceCode python` and
        # keyword / builtin tokens wrap in `<span class="hl-*">`.
        - ["<pre class=\"sourceCode python\"", "hl-keyword\">def</span>", "hl-function-builtin\">print</span>"]
      # Linked CSS must include the `.hl-keyword` rule — the default
      # highlight SCSS layer is always part of themed CSS.
      ensureCssRegexMatches:
        - ["\\.hl-keyword"]
---

Quarto highlights every fenced code block whose first class matches a
known language. The 14 built-in languages are `bash`/`sh`, `css`, `html`,
`javascript`/`js`/`jsx`, `json`, `julia`/`jl`, `lua`, `python`/`py`, `r`,
`sql`, `tsx`, `typescript`/`ts`, `yaml`/`yml`.

```python
def hello():
    print("Hello, World!")
```
